summary: A Lusail plastic surgery clinic appears to lose consultations to vague links, leftover text and no visible results or prices.

findings.problem: Careers appears to point to the contact page, Insurance and International Patients appear to point to the same page, and Request consult appears to have no clear destination.
findings.cost: Patients cannot find the right page and leave.

findings.problem: A design note such as phi equals 1.618 appears in the hero, and the brand appears as three different spellings.
findings.cost: Leftover notes and mixed names look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean hero text and one brand spelling.

findings.problem: The page appears to say consultants review real results but shows none, and no testimonials appear.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients buy on visible results.
findings.fix: A consented results gallery and reviews.

findings.problem: JCI standard appears three times with no certificate, the licence appears with no number, and no pricing appears despite promised pricing guidance.
findings.cost: Unverified claims and missing prices push patients to compare elsewhere.
findings.fix: Certificate and licence details and starting prices.
